purpose: Private reviewed intake example for future Clear Lake Watch field and microscopy records. Do not publish private working files.

records.custodyNotes: Private custody note; remove from public export.
records.fieldNotes: Private field notes; remove from public export.
records.qaNotes: Private QA note; remove from public export.
records.publicSummary: Example only. Not reviewed for publication.

publicExportRules: Only approved-public records with permissionToPublish true may enter public exports.
Private collector identity, custody notes, QA notes, raw photo paths, and sensitive coordinates must be removed before publication.
Field and microscopy records must remain a separate source family from FHABS, CLAMP, CEDEN, Tribal monitoring, and USGS hydrology.
